name: Atari Jaguar
description: Atari's last home console, released in 1993 and marketed as the first 64-bit system. Its two custom chips, Tom and Jerry, were powerful but hard to program, and few games used them well, so the system sold poorly against Sony and Sega.

specs.graphics: Tom: RISC GPU, Object Processor, blitter @ 26.59 MHz

curiosities: IBM manufactured the console for Atari.
Its marketing slogan was "Do the Math".
After Atari's exit, the case and cartridge molds were reused for dental imaging equipment.
Its controller has a 12-button numeric keypad that took game overlays.
